There is no indication of non-GAAP adjustments or one-time items that would affect the GAAP operating income figure of $63,734 million used in the calculation. The segment operating income totals ($66,595M per E15) reconcile to consolidated operating income after corporate-level adjustments. NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE.

H3 (Preliminary/Estimated figures): The counter-evidence (E18, E19, E20) discusses operating income by segment, tax payments, and capital returns but contains no language indicating the reported figures are preliminary, estimated, or subject to change.
